region, Can I use CardMedic on any device?

Yes, absolutely! CardMedic is device agnostic, which means it can be used on a mobile phone, tablet or desktop. In fact, as a Progressive Web App, it can even be used offline! You just need to hop back online occasionally to make the most of the free updates and enhancements when they are released.
